sweep_hydra_jobs: run a Hydra BasicSweeper to generate cartesian product jobs from comma-separated override arguments
split_arguments_into_batches: build a cartesian product of sweep overrides and split into batches using split_arguments
split_overrides_to_chunks: create chunks of override lists by splitting a list of lists into fixed-size batches
configure_basic_sweeper: build a BasicSweeperConf dataclass with max_batch_size and params for Hydra sweeper configuration
setup_sweeper_with_launcher: run the BasicSweeper setup method to instantiate a launcher from Hydra context and config
